verdict.rationale: Expensify documents a conversational AI that can create, categorize, approve and reject expenses in plain language, answer questions about the account, and build rules on request. That is a conversational assistant operating on expense policy, but nothing in the evidence shows it enforcing policy in the specific ways the story asks. Missing for 10: documented chasing of missing receipts, conversational explanations of declines, pre-spend "can I expense this?" policy answers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an AI assistant enforces policy conversationally — chasing missing receipts, explaining declines, and answering "can I expense this?" before the spend happens

citations.quote: Create, categorize, tag, approve, and reject expenses using plain language, no clicking required
Configure workspaces, build rules, and fix your own setup mistakes by just asking
Get instant answers and charts for anything in your account
Expensify uses your policies and past behavior to auto-categorize expenses as they're created.
